title: Civilization trader contact poses
sourcePreservation: All generated source PNGs are copied intact; no offline raster editing, cropping or recoloring.

rights.art: Original AI-generated assets, no third-party art downloaded or copied. Generated outputs are not warranted exclusive or free of every possible legal claim.
rights.historicalInspiration: Primary historical text/object context; palettes and readable uniforms are artistic choices. Camels and merchant roles are not exclusive to one civilization.

coverage.portrait: Native contact A source sampled directly

runtime.groundAnchor: Center of handler/animal group; per-frame physical coordinates adjusted after alpha trim
runtime.scale: 48 / measured source human body reference, constant across A/B for each civ
runtime.sourceSampling: Native source frame sampled once at DPR4. Whole authored silhouette, physical-pixel snapped 1:1 cached blit.
runtime.sourceLoading: Only selected civilizations are retained. Request serial guards obsolete completion/pruning. Historical v3 sources lazy only on failed current load; old generic trader not decoded.

researchReferences.use: Parent-provided primary historical reference for Roman tunic, cloak and pack mule; no source artwork imported.

assets.description: Roman civilian male adult handler in SHORT cream linen tunic with narrow restrained RED clavi stripes/red belt, leather sandals and simple belt purse, Mediterranean face, no helmet. One brown PACK MULE with long ears, leather harness, wicker panniers with two secured terracotta amphorae and linen sacks; mule small enough that its withers are roughly at handler waist/chest and head below human head.
assets.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: original transparent production RTS TRADER walking atlas. Image1 is material/style reference ONLY, Image2 faction historical architectural palette inspiration ONLY. Primary subject: Roman civilian male adult handler in SHORT cream linen tunic with narrow restrained RED clavi stripes/red belt, leather sandals and simple belt purse, Mediterranean face, no helmet. One brown PACK MULE with long ears, leather harness, wicker panniers with two secured terracotta amphorae and linen sacks; mule small enough that its withers are roughly at handler waist/chest and head below human head. Every view includes SAME one handler and SAME one pack animal, connected only by slack halter rein and enough air gap to read human body/legs. Cargo tied securely, no loose floating props. STRICT layout exactly4columns and2rows (8 complete pairs). Column headings left-to-right SE facing down-right, SW facing down-left, NE viewed from behind facing up-right, NW viewed behind facing up-left. Repeatallheadingsonbothrows. Row1 contactA: handler near leg/animal near foreleg fullyforward, farlegsback; row2 contactB: clearly different passing step, near knee bent/lifted, opposite footgrounded, animal forelegbent and visible farlegforward. Matching uniform/face/animal/size/halters/cargo identical acrossviews, limbs change coherently. NOT cloning one resting pose with wholebody shift. Fixed downward30degree orthographic isometric, soft upper-left light, mature natural proportions and realistic small adult heads. Detailed tactile cloth/leather/animalfur/terracotta/weaving, crisp painterly historicalminiature matching originalgameassets, no plastictoy/chibi/paperdoll. Native high resolution LANDSCAPE1774x887 or similar, each completepairfills generouscell but safealpha guttersallaround, uncut feet/ears/camelneck/humps/goods/reins. Truealpha background, NO opaque brown/black backdrop or groundplinth/island, no room/scene/architecture, no text/grid/label/UI/watermark. Civilian economic role, zero armor/shields/swords/spears/bows/muskets. Create original art, do not copy commercialgameassets or museumobject images. Historical clothing/animal/goods are artistic inspiration, not exclusive claims about any civilization.
